namespace Geometry.Services
{
    using System.Linq;

    public partial class ShapeService
    {
        partial void OnCreated() { Validate(); }
        public IEnumerable<string> Names(IEnumerable<Shape> shapes) =>
            from s in shapes where s.Area() > 0 orderby s.Area() select s.ToString();
        public int Count(IEnumerable<Shape> shapes) => shapes.Where(s => s.Area() > 1).Select(x => x.Perimeter()).Count();
        public void Validate() { Helper.Run(null); Run<int>(1); this.Validate(); base.ToString(); }
        static T Run<T>(T value) where T : struct => value;
    }

    public interface IShapeService { }

    namespace Inner
    {
        public class Nested
        {
            public class Deeper
            {
                public struct Leaf { public int Value; }
                public void Go() { new Leaf(); new Geometry.Core.Point(1, 2); new Dictionary<string, Owner>(); }
            }
            private Deeper.Leaf _leaf;
        }
    }
}
